This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Transaction amounts are kept and stored precisely as integer minor units (using integer arithmetic and bigint in the database), preventing floating point rounding errors. Currencies with no cents/minor units (such as the Japanese yen, JPY) are handled by setting minorDigits to 0, which is correctly parsed via Math.round and 10 ** minorDigits(currency) in src/util/money.ts.

label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts currently uses toISOString() for date formatting, which operates in UTC and causes dates to roll over prematurely during evening hours in local time zones like Pacific Time. Updating this function to use local date formatting will ensure export filenames correctly match the user's local date.

src/exportUtils.ts calls slugify(reportName) to generate the export filename base, and src/util/strings.ts defines slugify using a regex /[^a-z0-9]+/g which drops any non-ASCII characters such as Greek and Cyrillic. Updating the slugify implementation in src/util/strings.ts will ensure non-Latin characters are preserved in export filenames.
